title: Trigonometric Functions and Formulae
seo_title: Year 13 A Level Maths: Trigonometric Formulae Worksheets
standard_text: Understand and use sec, cosec and cot and arcsin, arccos and arctan; use sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ and cosec²θ = 1 + cot²θ; understand and use the double angle formulae and the formulae for sin(A ± B), cos(A ± B) and tan(A ± B).
meta_desc: Free Year 13 A level maths worksheets on trigonometric formulae: sec, cosec and cot, sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ, addition formulae, double angle formulae and exact values. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B.
key_sub: sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A; cos 2A = cos²A − sin²A.
body_html:
How it works

sec θ = 1/cos θ, cosec θ = 1/sin θ, cot θ = 1/tan θ. Identities: 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Addition formulae: sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B, cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B. Double angles: sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A, cos 2A = 2cos²A − 1 = 1 − 2sin²A.

Example

Exact value of sin 75°.

Answer: (√6 + √2)/4

Common mistakes

  • Writing sin(A + B) = sin A + sin B.
  • Mixing up the sign in cos(A + B).
  • Thinking sec θ = 1/sin θ.

faq.q: What are sec, cosec and cot?
faq.a: sec θ = 1/cos θ, cosec θ = 1/sin θ and cot θ = 1/tan θ.

faq.q: How do you find sin 2θ from cos θ?
faq.a: Find sin θ with sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 (check the sign from the quadrant), then use sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ.
